name: One-Pan Ground Turkey Thai Red Curry with Cauliflower Rice
ingredients_verbatim: 4 T Thai Red Curry Paste (more or less to taste)
one 13.6 oz. can unsweetened coconut milk
1 large red bell pepper, seeds removed and cut into strips
2 medium zucchini, but into half-moon slices
fresh lime pieces to squeeze on at the table (optional)
unmapped: Thai Red Curry Paste (signature ingredient; likely no Omaha board home - flag for pricer lane)
unsweetened coconut milk, canned (likely no board home)
peanut oil (board may track a generic cooking oil instead)
frozen cauliflower rice (board may track fresh cauliflower head instead)
why: Crumbled ground turkey braised in a one-pan Thai red curry with coconut milk, bell pepper, zucchini and cauliflower rice - meat + fat + non-starchy veg, no rice/pasta/potato/bread/bean base, so structurally low-carb and the published 407 cal / 13g carbs / 32g protein / 26g fat clears the 400-650 & <=35 band on the source's own numbers. Skillet-only (no bake), brown-and-simmer, scales cleanly to 14 servings (~2.3x). Adds Thai cuisine variety to a catalog that skews American/Tex-Mex. DEDUP NOTE: catalog has 'oneskillet-ground-turkey-thai-curry-with-rice' (a WITH-RICE, high-carb dish) - this is the cauliflower-rice low-carb build with different veg, and the rice version could not qualify in a low-carb run; I judge it a distinct low-carb dish but flag the overlap honestly for the adjudicators.
confidence: verified nutrition read directly from page. Two caveats: 407 cal sits near the band floor so our label-DB recompute could dip under 400 (26g fat gives some cushion); and there is a same-cuisine near-neighbor (thai-curry-with-rice) in the catalog - moderate confidence on both dedup and floor.
